projects.title: VPCI FIRST Tech Challenge Robotics (Oct 2023 - June 2025)
projects.description: Co-led programming for high school FTC Robotics Team, programming tele-op and autonomous opmodes. Demo video of autonomous program can be found in Show More.

coverImage.alt: Image of VPCI FIRST Tech Challenge Robots

modalData.description: In high school, I was my team's Programming Co-Lead for our FTC Robotics team. We had our rookie year in Gr. 11, and it was a fun experience learning to program both tele-op and autonomous modes when we didn't have much relevant prior experience. I was most proud that we got a 50-point auton working.
features: Uses model trained on pre-built FTC tooling to detect location of game-piece
Coordinates of detected game-piece used to decide where to place pixels
Path-planning and PIDS using the RoadRunner Odometry to path towards locations for placing pixels

projects.title: Smash - ICS3U7 Project
projects.description: Co-developed a simple fighting game inspired by Super Smash for our ICS3U7 Culminating Project. Includes a ranged and melee attack and player vs computer mode.

modalData.description: In ICS3U7, I co-developed a simple fighting game inspired by Super Smash for our ICS3U7 Culminating Project. Our fighter has a melee attack and a ranged attack, and there is a player-vs-computer mode, and a training mode where you can attack a dummy.
features: Modular code using OOP to use classes for the fighter, animations, etc...
Training mode where you can practice on a training dummy
